Users request deposits by specifying assets and expected shares, with assets transferred immediately to the vault 2. Users request withdrawals by specifying shares and expected assets, with no immediate transfer 3. A designated EOA manager processes requests when market conditions are favorable (fair pricing) 4. If requests expire (default 10 minutes) or conditions aren't favorable, users can cancel their requests 5. Users must wait between requests (default 1 day) to prevent rapid-fire interactions 6. The manager can approve vault funds for use by external protocols (e.g., PredictionMarketEscrow) 7. Emergency mode allows immediate proportional withdrawals using only vault balance KEY FEATURES: - Request-based deposit and withdrawal system with manager-controlled processing - Interaction delay acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

approveFundsUsage(address,uint256).details: Simplified from V1 - no utilization tracking, just approve if available

params.protocol: Address of the target protocol (e.g., PredictionMarketEscrow)

batchProcessDeposit(address[]).details: Processes each deposit request, reverts if any request fails

params.requesters: Array of addresses who made deposit requests

batchProcessWithdrawal(address[]).details: Processes each withdrawal request, reverts if any request fails

params.requesters: Array of addresses who made withdrawal requests

cancelDeposit().details: Can only be called after the request has expired, returns assets to user

cancelWithdrawal().details: Can only be called after the request has expired

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals of the underlying asset. This value is fetched and cached during construction of the vault contract. If the decimals() call fails during construction (e.g., the asset contract does not implement decimals()), a default of 18 is used. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

emergencyWithdraw(uint256).details: Only available in emergency mode, uses vault balance only (not deployed funds)      IMPORTANT: This only withdraws liquid assets. If the vault holds position tokens      from unsettled predictions, those are NOT included in the emergency withdrawal.      Users may need to wait for predictions to settle to recover full value.      Use getPredictionMarketTokenValue() to check for unredeemed position tokens.

returns._0: Number of shares available for transfer
Number of shares locked for withdrawal, 0 if no pending withdrawal

getPredictionMarketTokenValue(address,ad.details: Use this to check for unredeemed position tokens from predictions.      IMPORTANT: Emergency withdrawals do NOT include position token value.      Users should monitor this to understand full vault value.

returns.balance: The amount of position tokens held
returns.claimableValue: The claimable value if resolved (0 if unresolved)

getTotalLiquidValue().details: Position token values must be queried separately using getPredictionMarketTokenValue()      as the vault doesn't track which position tokens it holds.

returns.unconfirmedDeposits: Assets from pending deposits (not yet confirmed)

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

processDeposit(address).details: Mints shares to the user and marks the request as processed

params.requestedBy: Address of the user who made the deposit request

processWithdrawal(address).details: Burns shares and transfers assets to the user, marks request as processed

params.requestedBy: Address of the user who made the withdrawal request

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

requestDeposit(uint256,uint256).details: The request will expire after expirationTime and can be cancelled by the user

params.assets: Number of assets to deposit (transferred immediately to vault)
params.expectedShares: Expected shares to receive (used for validation by manager)

requestWithdrawal(uint256,uint256).details: The request will expire after expirationTime and can be cancelled by the user

params.expectedAssets: Expected assets to receive (used for validation by manager)

params.newExpirationTime: New expiration time in seconds (after which requests can be cancelled)

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

approveFundsUsage(address,uint256).notice: Approve funds usage to an external protocol

batchProcessDeposit(address[]).notice: Batch process multiple pending deposit requests (manager only)

batchProcessWithdrawal(address[]).notice: Batch process multiple pending withdrawal requests (manager only)

cancelDeposit().notice: Cancel a pending deposit request after expiration time

cancelWithdrawal().notice: Cancel a pending withdrawal request after expiration time

emergencyWithdraw(uint256).notice: Emergency withdrawal (bypasses delay and uses proportional vault balance)

expirationTime().notice: Expiration time in seconds for user requests before they can be cancelled (default: 10 minutes)

getAvailableShares(address).notice: Get the number of shares available for transfer (total balance minus locked shares)

getLockedShares(address).notice: Get the number of shares locked for a pending withdrawal request

getPredictionMarketTokenValue(address,ad.notice: Get the value of a position token held by this vault

getTotalLiquidValue().notice: Get the total value of the vault including liquid assets

interactionDelay().notice: Interaction delay in seconds between user requests (default: 1 day)

lastUserInteractionTimestamp(address).notice: Mapping of user to their last interaction timestamp (used to enforce interaction delay)

manager().notice: The EOA manager who can approve funds for use by protocols

pendingRequests(address).notice: Mapping of user to their pending request (only one request per user at a time)

processDeposit(address).notice: Process a pending deposit request (manager only)

processWithdrawal(address).notice: Process a pending withdrawal request (manager only)

requestDeposit(uint256,uint256).notice: Request deposit of assets - creates a pending request that the manager can process

requestWithdrawal(uint256,uint256).notice: Request withdrawal of shares - creates a pending request that the manager can process

setExpirationTime(uint256).notice: Set expiration time for user requests

setInteractionDelay(uint256).notice: Set interaction delay between user requests
